name: F1 1990
author: Swofty
description: Turns the F1 2026 season into the 1990 season: 1990 teams, drivers, calendar, rules and cars, in Driver Career and Grand Prix.

options.label: Soft sets per session
options.description: New soft tyre sets handed out in each of practice 1, practice 2, Friday qualifying, Saturday qualifying and the race. No medium or hard sets are given.

options.label: Steering wheel display
options.description: The dial the 1990 cars show: the F2 dial, with no ERS or override readouts, or the modern F1 dial.

options.label: No active aero
options.description: Turns off the 2026 active aero rules on the 2026 cars.

options.label: ERS
options.description: Removed takes the hybrid system out of the cars. Zeroed keeps it with no harvest, deploy or override, for when removal misbehaves.
